2607.14512.title: RetroAgent: Harnessing LLMs to Search Over Structured Memory for Agentic Retrosynthesis Planning
2607.14512.paper_summary: Multi-step retrosynthesis planning seeks to decompose a target molecule into commercially available building blocks through a sequence of feasible reactions. The vast combinatorial search space makes this task challenging even for expert chemists. Traditional methods combine tree search with offline-trained value networks that score candidates in isolation, without reasoning about complete multi-step routes. Recent work leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) for this task, but relies on simple interfaces that limit exploration of the full search space. We introduce RetroAgent, an LLM agent that bridges symbolic search and neural reasoning through a harness with structured memory. Through memory and chemistry tools, the agent observes the full search state, including explored routes, available alternatives, and properties of intermediates, enabling informed decisions grounded in both global progress and domain knowledge. Experiments on in-distribution and out-of-distribution benchmarks demonstrate that RetroAgent delivers strong performance and generalization.
2607.14512.paper_summary_zh: 多步逆合成規劃旨在通過一系列可行的反應將目標分子分解為商業可用的構建塊。龐大的組合搜索空間使這項任務對專家化學家來說也充滿挑戰。傳統方法將樹搜索與離線訓練的價值網絡結合，這些網絡在孤立的情況下評分候選者，而不考慮完整的多步路徑。最近的研究利用大型語言模型（LLMs）來處理這項任務，但依賴於簡單的介面，限制了對完整搜索空間的探索。我們介紹了RetroAgent，一個通過結構化記憶的裝置將符號搜索和神經推理相結合的LLM代理。通過記憶和化學工具，該代理觀察完整的搜索狀態，包括已探索的路徑、可用的替代方案和中間體的性質，使其能夠基於全球進展和領域知識做出明智的決策。在分佈內和分佈外基準上的實驗表明，RetroAgent展現了強大的性能和泛化能力。
